summary: Legacy network playbooks with connection: local can still use provider authorize and auth_pass for enable mode, but become is recommended as provider dicts will be deprecated.
questions: Can I still use authorize and auth_pass for enable mode?
Should I migrate from provider authorize to become?

answer_card.title: Legacy authorize and auth_pass
answer_card.answer_md:
With `connection: local`, legacy playbooks can still use:

```yaml
provider:
  authorize: true
  auth_pass: "{{ secret_auth_pass }}"
```

Migrate to `become`; `authorize` and `provider` will be deprecated.
